metadata.description: Offline bundled AppImage: verify link and credit-sharing owners report unavailable rather than claiming an unknown remote identity, the authoritative credit balance is signed out, and local work remains available; then import the unchanged authentic 430×880 portrait app capture, initialize the pinned phone candidate preset, create an app-only plain/contain physical still with display raster derived from the exact device metric, select CPU (bounded 600-second render budget), and render/download the managed-Blender PNG. Also checks AI Gateway and Workspace Sandbox unavailable in the packaged offline app. Compile the exact saved shot revision before submitting its native render.
metadata.name: desktop-offline-native-3d-still

evaluate.expression: (async()=>{const url='http://192.0.2.1:81/offline-probe-initial';let csp=false;const onViolation=e=>{if(String(e.blockedURI).includes('192.0.2.1'))csp=true};document.addEventListener('securitypolicyviolation',onViolation);const controller=new AbortController();let timedOut=false,resolved=false,failure='';const timeout=setTimeout(()=>{timedOut=true;controller.abort()},2000);try{await fetch(url,{mode:'no-cors',credentials:'omit',cache:'no-store',signal:controller.signal});resolved=true}catch(error){failure=String(error)}finally{clearTimeout(timeout)}await new Promise(resolve=>setTimeout(resolve,0));document.removeEventListener('securitypolicyviolation',onViolation);const observed=performance.getEntriesByName(url).length>0;if(resolved||timedOut||csp||!observed)throw new Error('External TEST-NET denial not proven: '+JSON.stringify({resolved,timedOut,csp,resourceTimingObserved:observed,failure}));return {url,rejected:true,resourceTimingObserved:observed,error:failure}})()

(()=>{const account=document.querySelector(`[data-testid=\"page-settings-account-status\"]`)?.textContent?.trim()||'';const capabilities=document.querySelector(`[data-testid=\"settings-credit-session\"]`)?.textContent||'';const balance=document.querySelector(`[data-testid=\"settings-credit-balance\"]`)?.textContent||'';if(!account.includes('Account owner unavailable'))throw new Error('Expected honest offline link-owner state; got '+account);if(!capabilities.includes('Credential owner unavailable'))throw new Error('Expected honest offline credit-sharing owner state; got '+capabilities.trim());if(!balance.includes('Sign in to view'))throw new Error('Expected no authenticated credit balance; got '+balance.trim());if(!document.body.innerText.includes('Local authoring and rendering work offline'))throw new Error('Missing offline local-work availability statement');return {accountState:'owner_unavailable',creditShareState:'owner_unavailable',balanceState:'signed_out',localWork:'available'}})()

(()=>{const label=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('label')).find(x=>x.textContent.includes('Saved physical setup'));const s=label?.querySelector('select');if(!s?.value||!s.selectedOptions[0]?.textContent?.includes('candidate'))throw new Error('Phone starter did not resolve to a saved candidate setup');const scene=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('label')).find(x=>x.textContent.includes('Scene candidate'))?.querySelector('select');if(!scene?.value)throw new Error('Pinned starter scene revision is not selected');return {preset:s.value,presetLabel:s.selectedOptions[0].textContent.trim(),scene:scene.value}})()

(()=>{const e=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('label')).find(x=>x.textContent.includes('Device candidate'))?.querySelector('select');if(!e?.value)throw new Error('Exact starter device revision is not selected');return {deviceRevision:e.value}})()

(()=>{const s=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('label')).find(x=>x.textContent.includes('Screen source'))?.querySelector('select');if(!s?.value||!s.selectedOptions[0]?.textContent?.includes('430 × 880'))throw new Error('Imported app source was not selected for the physical display');return {source:s.selectedOptions[0].textContent.trim()}})()

(()=>{const all=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('label.shot-field select'));const has=(select,text)=>Array.from(select.options).some(option=>option.textContent?.trim()===text);const area=all.find(select=>has(select,'Already composed'));const kind=all.find(select=>has(select,'Plain capture'));const fit=all.find(select=>has(select,'Contain'));if(!area||!kind||!fit)throw new Error('Screen presentation controls for app-only/plain/contain are missing');const setter=Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLSelectElement.prototype,'value')?.set;if(!setter)throw new Error('Native select setter is unavailable');for(const select of [area,kind,fit]){setter.call(select,'1');select.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true}));}return {captureArea:area.value,kind:kind.value,fitMode:fit.value}})()

(()=>{const all=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('label.shot-field select'));const has=(select,text)=>Array.from(select.options).some(option=>option.textContent?.trim()===text);const area=all.find(select=>has(select,'Already composed'));const kind=all.find(select=>has(select,'Plain capture'));const fit=all.find(select=>has(select,'Contain'));const values={captureArea:area?.value,kind:kind?.value,fitMode:fit?.value};if(values.captureArea!=='1'||values.kind!=='1'||values.fitMode!=='1')throw new Error('Expected explicit APP_ONLY/PLAIN/CONTAIN presentation, got '+JSON.stringify(values));return values})()

(()=>{const s=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('label')).find(x=>x.textContent.includes('Render backend'))?.querySelector('select');if(!s||s.value!=='CPU')throw new Error('CPU backend was not explicitly selected');return {backend:s.value}})()

(()=>{const original=window.fetch.bind(window);window.__deviceStudioCreateShotProbe=[];window.fetch=(input,init)=>{const raw=input instanceof Request?input.url:String(input);let parsed;try{parsed=new URL(raw,location.href)}catch{return original(input,init)}if(!parsed.pathname.endsWith('/vrooli.device_studio.v1.shots.ShotsService/CreateShot'))return original(input,init);const rec={url:parsed.origin+parsed.pathname,method:init?.method||'GET',state:'pending',status:null,durationMs:null,error:null};window.__deviceStudioCreateShotProbe.push(rec);const started=performance.now();return original(input,init).then(response=>{rec.state='response';rec.status=response.status;rec.durationMs=Math.round(performance.now()-started);void response.clone().json().then(body=>{const error=body?.error||body;if(error?.message)rec.error={code:String(error.code||'').slice(0,80),message:String(error.message).replace(/(bearer|token|password|secret)[^ ]*/ig,'[redacted]').slice(0,240)}}).catch(()=>{});return response},error=>{rec.state='network-error';rec.durationMs=Math.round(performance.now()-started);rec.error=String(error).replace(/(bearer|token|password|secret)[^ ]*/ig,'[redacted]').slice(0,240);throw error})};return {installed:true,origin:location.origin}})()

(async()=>{const waitFor=async(fn,ms)=>{const end=Date.now()+ms;while(Date.now()<end){const value=fn();if(value)return value;await new Promise(resolve=>setTimeout(resolve,100))}return null};const alerts=()=>Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('[role=alert]')).map(e=>e.textContent?.trim()).filter(Boolean).slice(0,5);const editor=await waitFor(()=>document.querySelector('[data-testid="physical-shot-editor"]'),15000);const calls=window.__deviceStudioCreateShotProbe||[];if(!editor)throw new Error('CreateShot did not open the editor within 15s; API calls='+JSON.stringify(calls)+'; alerts='+JSON.stringify(alerts()));const button=await waitFor(()=>Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).find(e=>e.textContent?.includes('Render physical still')&&!e.disabled),15000);if(!button)throw new Error('Physical still render control is unavailable after 15s; CreateShot calls='+JSON.stringify(calls)+'; alerts='+JSON.stringify(alerts())+'; visibleText='+document.body.innerText.slice(-4000));button.click();const view=await waitFor(()=>{const ready=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).find(e=>e.textContent?.includes('View final PNG'));if(ready)return ready;const status=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('[role=status]')).map(e=>e.textContent?.trim()).filter(Boolean).join(' | ');if(/\bfailed\b/i.test(status))throw new Error('Native render entered failed state: '+status+'; alerts='+JSON.stringify(alerts()));return null},600000);if(!view)throw new Error('Submitted still did not reach a successful output state within 240s; alerts='+JSON.stringify(alerts()));view.click();const link=await waitFor(()=>document.querySelector('a.shot-download'),15000);const image=await waitFor(()=>document.querySelector('.shot-final-stage img'),15000);if(!link||!image||!link.download.endsWith('.png')||!image.complete||image.naturalWidth!==2560||image.naturalHeight!==1440)throw new Error('Rendered output is not a complete 2560x1440 PNG with a visible image and download link');const response=await fetch(link.href);if(!response.ok)throw new Error('Rendered PNG blob fetch failed with status '+response.status);const bytes=await response.arrayBuffer();const digest=await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256',bytes);const sha=Array.from(new Uint8Array(digest),b=>b.toString(16).padStart(2,'0')).join('');const data=new Uint8Array(bytes);if(data.length<24||data[0]!==137||data[1]!==80||data[2]!==78||data[3]!==71)throw new Error('Rendered output bytes do not have a PNG signature');const details=document.querySelector('.shot-render-result details')?.textContent||'';return {width:image.naturalWidth,height:image.naturalHeight,downloadName:link.download,byteLength:bytes.byteLength,sha256:sha,signature:'PNG',metadata:details.trim(),createShotCalls:calls}})()

(()=>{for(const id of ['ai-gateway','workspace-sandbox']){const row=document.querySelector('[data-testid=\"settings-capability-'+id+'\"]');if(!row||row.dataset.status!=='unavailable')throw new Error('Expected offline optional capability '+id+' to be unavailable');if(!row.textContent?.includes('local project work remains available'))throw new Error('Missing local-work guidance for '+id)}return {aiGateway:'unavailable',workspaceSandbox:'unavailable',localProjectWork:'available'}})()
